scope: Proposition 2.7 of the manuscript “Prescribed large-volume charges on threefolds with trivial canonical bundle” (preprints/Prescribed-large-volume-charges-on-threefolds-with-trivial-canonical-bundle-September-24-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 055 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 84ce978a67015704), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 15. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: For either factor in (2.13), the choices in Lemma 2.6 can be made so that every B ∈ V, H ∈ W, t ≥ T gives a locally finite geometric stability condition on X, with charge (2.16) and full numerical support. Every point sheaf is stable of phase 1. For Θ = 1, the construction also gives compatible geometric slicings on every smooth section Sh ∈ |Lh|, with Harder–Narasimhan phases computed by pushforward to Y .
